text: In every category, a morphism is an epimorphism if and only if it is surjective on underlying elements.
explanation: False. Epimorphism means right-cancellable, which coincides with surjectivity only in special categories like Set. In Ring the inclusion ℤ ↪ ℚ is an epimorphism yet is far from surjective — a morphism is epi when its image determines everything, not necessarily when it is everything.
